summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completed private placement of $120.0 million aggregate principal of 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, sold to qualified institutional buyers under note purchase agreements dated July 29, 2026. Net proceeds will fund Phase 1 construction and equipment for its G2_Austin solar cell fab and general corporate purposes, intended as bridge financing ahead of a comprehensive debt-backed capital solution. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, convertible into common stock with registration rights requiring a resale registration statement within 30 days. This is a routine debt financing, not a special-situation event.
